events.title: ROC Holiday Village
events.blurb: Opens Black Friday: free outdoor skating, a shopping village, Santa’s Workshop, fire pits and food trucks downtown.
events.blurbEs: Abre el Black Friday: patinaje gratis al aire libre, mercado navideño, el taller de Santa, fogatas y food trucks.

events.title: The Nutcracker
events.blurb: Rochester City Ballet dances the holiday classic with the Rochester Philharmonic playing live.
events.blurbEs: El Rochester City Ballet baila el clásico navideño con la Filarmónica de Rochester en vivo.

events.title: A Christmas Carol
events.blurb: Geva’s yearly staging of Dickens, with kids’ tickets (ages 5–12) from $24.
events.blurbEs: La versión anual de Geva del cuento de Dickens; boletos para niños (5 a 12) desde $24.

events.title: Holiday Laser
events.blurb: Holiday songs set to lasers on the planetarium dome. Saturday night also has Laser Daft Punk and Dark Side of the Moon.
events.blurbEs: Canciones navideñas con láseres en la cúpula. El sábado de noche también hay Laser Daft Punk y Dark Side of the Moon.

events.title: Holiday Wine & Craft Marketplace
events.blurb: Gifts from 40 local artisans, bakers and distillers, plus holiday wines, wine slushies and mimosas.
events.blurbEs: Regalos de 40 artesanos, panaderos y destiladores locales, con vinos navideños, granizados de vino y mimosas.

events.title: Native Made Market
events.blurb: Indigenous artists sell beadwork, art, leather goods and fashion, with runway shows at 11, 1:40 and 3:30.
events.blurbEs: Artistas indígenas venden abalorios, arte, cuero y moda, con desfiles a las 11, 1:40 y 3:30.

events.title: Themata Holiday Homemade Market
events.blurb: A big handmade market in the old armory for Black Friday and Small Business Saturday. Free parking.
events.blurbEs: Un gran mercado artesanal en la antigua armería para el Black Friday y el sábado de pequeños negocios. Estacionamiento gratis.

events.title: Holidays at the Market
events.blurb: The first Sunday of the city’s holiday market: fresh-cut trees and wreaths, local food, crafts and holiday lights.
events.blurbEs: El primer domingo del mercado navideño de la ciudad: árboles y coronas, comida local, artesanías y luces.
